summary: src/StihlRangeResolver.js is the sole module executed by Node.js in production (server.js and src/decoder.js import .js). src/StihlRangeResolver.ts was created in commit 40d3cb7 and never updated, creating serious semantic divergence.

divergences.StihlRangeResolver_js: Uses ranges.filter(...) followed by deterministic sort by plant specificity and narrowest range span. Returns null if matches.length !== 1 to prevent silent conflict resolution.
divergences.StihlRangeResolver_ts: Uses ranges.find(...) which suffers from silent first-match bias.

divergences.StihlRangeResolver_js: Contains zero hardcoded era fallbacks. If no range in database matches, it returns null cleanly.
divergences.StihlRangeResolver_ts: Contains hardcoded Plant 1 fallback logic (>=180M -> 2016-Heden, >=170M -> 2010-2016, >=140M -> 2000-2010) and default 'Ca. 2011 – 2020'.

divergences.StihlRangeResolver_js: Returns range_id, model_id, model_name, plant_code, serial_start, serial_end, yearRangeFormatted, yearStart, yearEnd, generation, confidence, source_class, source_ref, evidence_scope, seriesSummary.
divergences.StihlRangeResolver_ts: Returns only yearRangeFormatted, yearStart, yearEnd, generation, confidence, seriesSummary. Lacks model_id and range metadata.

action_required: Align src/StihlRangeResolver.ts with the production-tested logic of src/StihlRangeResolver.js to prevent future developer confusion, while ensuring src/StihlRangeResolver.js remains the single runtime authority.
